Chapter 1070: 15: Lin Yuan And Nine Profound Venerable (Request For Monthly Votes)

Chapter 1070: Chapter 15: Lin Yuan and Nine Profound Venerable (Request for Monthly Votes)

The expression on Nine Profound Venerable’s face was solemn.

The young man who suddenly appeared before him exuded a strange aura, yet there was an indistinct sense of threat emanating from him.

It was clear that he was also a Chaos Venerable.

“That boy is no longer inside the secret realm.”

Nine Profound Venerable’s eyes narrowed slightly. He had left a contingency on Cang Yulong, allowing him to easily pinpoint his location.

Although Cang Yulong’s causal threads were now obscured and under concealment, there was no doubt he had completely vanished.

“Two Venerables—one forcibly took the boy away, while the other held me back?”

Nine Profound Venerable looked at the young man not far away. If not for Lin Yuan’s sudden appearance, forcing him into high alert, he could have locked onto Cang Yulong’s position in the instant he tore through the time and space of the secret realm.

“Not two Venerables; it must be a main body and an avatar of a Venerable.”

Nine Profound Venerable surmised in his heart.

For an Eleventh-Tier lifeform to ascend to the Twelfth Tier, it required an ultimate leap.

During this ultimate leap, in order to consolidate all forces to break through to the Twelfth Tier, it was necessary to recall all external psychic consciousness.

The essence of an avatar is the partitioning of part of the original self’s psychic consciousness, then using this psychic fragment as the core to form a duplicate, enabling shared consciousness.

Recalling all external psychic consciousness meant the collapse of all avatars.

As for after ascending to the Twelfth Tier, attempting to reform new avatars… the difficulty would increase exponentially, and it would also significantly impact the main body in various aspects.

Thus.

Many Twelfth-Tier beings were unwilling to refine avatars, as it would reduce the battle strength of their true selves.

As for Lin Yuan’s two primordial spirits, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit and the Taiyang Divine Spirit, they remained even before and after his breakthrough to the Twelfth Tier because they were not strictly considered avatars.

Instead, they were unique derivatives of the Martial Arts Evolution Road.

Among the myriad evolutionary paths within the Chaos Void, some unique paths would unlock many special methods; primordial spirits were such special methods within the Martial Arts Evolution Road.

…

Far beyond countless billions of layers of space-time from the Nine Profound Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan carried Cang Yulong as he moved swiftly, each step crossing through layers of space-time and spanning billions upon billions of light-years.

“Senior…”

Cang Yulong felt the increasing distance between himself and the Nine Profound Secret Realm. Each step Lin Yuan took would take him hundreds or even thousands of years to traverse with his own speed.

“Is this the power of a Venerable at the Eightfold Realm of Space-Time?”

Cang Yulong silently marveled in his heart. In the art of overlapping and shifting through space-time, even Nine Profound Venerable seemed inferior compared to this mysterious Venerable before him.

“What on earth did my Stone People Clan’s ancestors do to be connected to such an existence?”

Cang Yulong steadied his mind, but an inexplicable curiosity began to arise within him.

…

“We’ve managed to shake him off for now.”

Lin Yuan cast a glance at the location of the Nine Profound Secret Realm.

This time, during the operation, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit assisted Cang Yulong in contesting against many of the restrictive bindings within the secret realm, while the Taiyang Divine Spirit was responsible for holding off Nine Profound Venerable.

Everything had gone smoothly; Cang Yulong had already been successfully rescued.

Next, all depended on the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

…

Within the Nine Profound Secret Realm.

The grand hall at the highest point.

Nine Profound Venerable stared at Lin Yuan, the two locked in a faint standoff.

“Venerable, Venerable, Cang Yulong, that boy is gone.” Several subordinates at the Path Splitting Realm immediately contacted Nine Profound Venerable. They had been tasked with guarding the Sinful Pool, torturing Cang Yulong day and night.

However, just now, they finally realized that Cang Yulong’s aura had disappeared.

“Useless fools.” Nine Profound Venerable couldn’t be bothered to reply or harshly reprimand his subordinates.

The one who acted was a Venerable, a true body or avatar, catching even him off guard, let alone subordinates at the Path Splitting Realm.

“Nine Profound Venerable, I’ve taken the boy.” Lin Yuan spoke up.

With Cang Yulong now under his protection, Nine Profound Venerable essentially had no means to intervene anymore.

As for methods like Causal Curse Killing? At the level of a Venerable, cursing and killing a Path Splitting Realm lifeform posed no challenge.

But the prerequisite was the absence of another strong individual at the same level to intervene. Techniques such as Causal Curse Killing could be blocked by external forces. For instance, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm could isolate causality and nullify curses.

“I’m quite curious.” Nine Profound Venerable fixed his gaze on Lin Yuan. “For you to utilize your true self on my home turf and forcibly take Cang Yulong, you must also be aware of that Mysterious Space.”

Lin Yuan’s actions placed him directly against Nine Profound Venerable. Without an irresistible benefit or reward, no Venerable would act in such a way.

At the Chaos Realm, conflicts between Venerables were rarely waged unless absolutely necessary. In the Chaos Void, every Venerable was considered to stand at the pinnacle.

It was precisely for this reason.

Nine Profound Venerable concluded that Lin Yuan was also aware of the Mysterious Space.

If this weren’t the case, how could a weak clan like the Stone People Clan attract the aid of another Venerable? And at the cost of utterly offending another Venerable, no less.

“Indeed, I am aware.” Lin Yuan nodded.

Nine Profound Venerable’s analysis was correct. If Cang Yulong hadn’t willingly offered the Chaos Tree and that Mysterious Space of inheritance suppressed by it…

Lin Yuan wouldn’t have intervened to rescue him. Doing so was tantamount to completely antagonizing Nine Profound Venerable.

“You’ve taken Cang Yulong, but you likely don’t know the exact coordinates of the Mysterious Space and would require him to tell you, correct?”

“I had tortured Cang Yulong day and night, yet he never divulged it. He wouldn’t reveal it to you unconditionally either—he must have made demands, like ensuring his rescue? Or perhaps saving the entire Stone People Clan?”

Nine Profound Venerable’s gaze turned a shade colder as he stared at Lin Yuan. “You’ve already taken Cang Yulong with you. Yet, you haven’t left. I assume your next target is the Stone People Clan? Cang Yulong’s condition must have been for you to rescue the Stone People Clan.”
